We lead in providing innovative, business-relevant services in Edge AI and IoT, Fabric, SDN/NFV for Edge Cloud, Edge Baremetal, Secure Access Services Edge and Elastic Edge.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: IT Support Officer

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The IT Support Officer is responsible for IT infrastructures proactive monitoring and provides Desktop support, LAN/Wireless connectivity, Endpoint vulnerability &amp; Patch Management, Printer services, quick provisioning of systems.
	The role also includes support services for other infrastructural platforms as stipulated by the IT Manager.


Principal Accountabilities &amp; Responsibilities


	Provides helpdesk support duties to all users in the company including installation and configuration of desktops and laptops.
	Ensures the daily / monthly backup of data in all INQ offices including Abuja and Port Harcourt and liaising with the IT Contact personnel in each of the offices on all IT related issues.
	Provides required IT-support which includes but not limited to Windows Operating Systems and Server Applications, w/ RAID 1 &amp; 5 etc.
	Troubleshoot and resolve of LAN/Wireless issues and uptime availability of network printers.
	Installs or modifies existing installations of networked computer hardware, software, and other components.
	Ensuring that the firewall security aspect of the IT overall security implementation is maintained and functional.
	Monitoring of IT NetBoz EMS in all our Data center and Camera Surveillance system uptime.
	Remote access support and system security update across all of hardware and software platforms.
	Work with internal customers to activate services; and assist with problem resolution as required.
	IT inventory tracking and management.
	On-call and after-hours support


Requirements


	Education, qualifications and special training: BSc / HND Computer Science / Engineering
	MCSE / MCP / CCNA / CCNP Experience: Helpdesk services System &amp; Network Administration Network security System administration and support.


Communication &amp; Work Relationships:


	Internal: The role will involve interfacing and communication with all stakeholders on a regular basis.
	Other Business Units: All Departments.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: inqngcareers@inq.inc using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

IT Support Officer Job at Inq Digital Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Inq Digital Nigeria Limited - Since 2013 our mission has been to be the number oneinnovative edge solutionsprovider on the African continent, focusing on Edge Computing. We lead in providing innovative, business-relevant services in Edge AI and IoT, Fabric, SDN/NFV for Edge Cloud, Edge Baremetal, Secure Access Services Edge and Elastic Edge.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: IT Support Officer

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The IT Support Officer is responsible for IT infrastructures proactive monitoring and provides Desktop support, LAN/Wireless connectivity, Endpoint vulnerability & Patch Management, Printer services, quick provisioning of systems.
	The role also includes support services for other infrastructural platforms as stipulated by the IT Manager.


Principal Accountabilities & Responsibilities


	Provides helpdesk support duties to all users in the company including installation and configuration of desktops and laptops.
	Ensures the daily / monthly backup of data in all INQ offices including Abuja and Port Harcourt and liaising with the IT Contact personnel in each of the offices on all IT related issues.
	Provides required IT-support which includes but not limited to Windows Operating Systems and Server Applications, w/ RAID 1 & 5 etc.
	Troubleshoot and resolve of LAN/Wireless issues and uptime availability of network printers.
	Installs or modifies existing installations of networked computer hardware, software, and other components.
	Ensuring that the firewall security aspect of the IT overall security implementation is maintained and functional.
	Monitoring of IT NetBoz EMS in all our Data center and Camera Surveillance system uptime.
	Remote access support and system security update across all of hardware and software platforms.
	Work with internal customers to activate services; and assist with problem resolution as required.
	IT inventory tracking and management.
	On-call and after-hours support


Requirements


	Education, qualifications and special training: BSc / HND Computer Science / Engineering
	MCSE / MCP / CCNA / CCNP Experience: Helpdesk services System & Network Administration Network security System administration and support.


Communication & Work Relationships:


	Internal: The role will involve interfacing and communication with all stakeholders on a regular basis.
	Other Business Units: All Departments.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

HR Officer Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is a human resources solutions company dedicated to helping businesses build stronger teams and manage people functions more effectively. Established in Nigeria in 2013, we have supported organizations for years with high-quality, practical HR services designed to meet real business needs; adapting to evolving workforce demands and enabling long-term growth. With a strong presence in Lagos and Ibadan, and an expanding footprint through Ascentforce in India, we deliver a broader, more connected approach to recruitment, outsourcing, training, and ongoing HR support. Ascentech brings expertise across borders, backed by over 13 years of dedicated experience in delivering practical HR and recruitment solutions.
     

            
    



We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HR Officer
Job Location: Kebbi
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking an organized and proactive HR Officer to support daily HR operations, employee relations, recruitment, attendance, documentation, and compliance.


Key Responsibilities


	Support recruitment, screening, interviews, onboarding, and employee documentation.
	Maintain accurate employee records, attendance, leave, and HR files.
	Handle employee enquiries and support employee relations.
	Assist with payroll preparation and statutory documentation.
	Support performance management, training, and staff welfare activities.
	Ensure compliance with company HR policies and Nigerian labour regulations.
	Prepare HR reports and provide administrative support to management.


Requirements


	BSc/HND in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business Administration, or related field.
	2–4 years of HR experience preferred.
	Good knowledge of HR processes, employee relations, and documentation.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office/Excel; HRIS experience is an advantage.
	Strong communication, organization, and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently and maintain confidentiality.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “HR Officer – 14” as the subject of the email.

  "title": "Senior Data Engineer",
  "description": "BlueChip Technologies is a leading business application firm focused exclusively on assisting organizations in planning, designing, implementing and operating business application solutions and strategies that are central to creating and maintaining a competitive business advantage.

We are &nbsp;recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Senior Data Engineer

Job Location: Lagos (Hybrid)

Description


	As part of our continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Services Division.
	This is a permanent, client-embedded role supporting tier-1 telecom customers, where you will build, operate, and continuously enhance large-scale Apache Open-Source Lakehouse and analytics platforms.
	The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring platform reliability, delivering new analytics use cases, and serving as a trusted technical partner to our client.

Senior Data Engineer Job at BlueChip Technologies




        
    

        
        BlueChip Technologies is a leading business application firm focused exclusively on assisting organizations in planning, designing, implementing and operating business application solutions and strategies that are central to creating and maintaining a competitive business advantage.

We are  recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Senior Data Engineer

Job Location: Lagos (Hybrid)

Description
     

            
    




	As part of our continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Services Division.
	This is a permanent, client-embedded role supporting tier-1 telecom customers, where you will build, operate, and continuously enhance large-scale Apache Open-Source Lakehouse and analytics platforms.
	The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring platform reliability, delivering new analytics use cases, and serving as a trusted technical partner to our client.


Key Responsibilities


	Design, develop, test, and maintain large-scale data pipelines using Apache Kafka, Spark/PySpark, Flink, Airflow, Trino, and Apache Iceberg/Delta Lake.
	Build and support Bronze, Silver, and Gold medallion-layer data pipelines processing high-volume telecom data at terabyte and petabyte scale.
	Design and implement dimensional (Kimball-aligned) data models, including fact tables, dimension tables, star schemas, and slowly changing dimensions (SCDs).
	Contribute to data platform architecture by defining partitioning strategies, schema evolution, and storage optimization.
	Serve as the primary technical point of contact for client data engineering requirements, participating in client meetings and resolving operational issues within agreed service levels.
	Translate business and analytics requirements into scalable data pipelines and reusable data products.
	Monitor pipeline performance, investigate and resolve data quality issues, and implement monitoring, alerting, and observability for production environments.
	Maintain architecture documentation, runbooks, data dictionaries, and technical documentation to ensure knowledge continuity and reduce key-person dependency.
	Mentor junior and mid-level Data Engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
	Collaborate with Data Architects, BI Developers, Data Analysts, and Project Managers to deliver high-quality data solutions aligned with business objectives and project timelines.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
	Minimum of 6 years of professional experience in Data Engineering, including at least 3 years supporting large-scale (terabyte/petabyte) data platforms.
	Proven hands-on experience with the Apache Open-Source ecosystem, including Apache Spark (PySpark), Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, andApache Iceberg or Delta Lake.
	Strong SQL expertise and practical experience designing and implementing dimensional (Kimball) data models.
	Experience building and supporting Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) Lakehouse solutions with robust data quality and reconcilisation processes.
	Strong Python programming skills for data engineering, automation, testing, and pipeline development.
	Experience working within Linux and cloud-based environments.
	Experience with telecom data sources such as Call Detail Records (CDRs), OSS/BSS systems, network probe data, or similar large-scale datasets is highly desirable.
	Experience with Huawei network probe data ingestion will be considered a significant advantage.
	Familiarity with workflow orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.


Key Competencies:


	Strong client engagement and stakeholder management skills.
	Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
	Demonstrated ownership mindset with strong documentation practices.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities across operational support and new solution delivery.
	Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
	Collaborative team player with experience mentoring junior engineers.
	Reliable, dependable, and comfortable working within a client-embedded hybrid environment.


What We Offer


	Competitive, performance-driven salary package.
	Comprehensive health insurance and employee benefits.
	Pension and retirement savings plan.
	Continuous learning, technical certifications, and professional development opportunities.
	Exposure to enterprise-scale data engineering projects and emerging technologies.
	A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive work environment.
	Hybrid work model with modern tools and technologies.
